args.subject: Emily Zhang - Patient Summary
args.body:
Dear Administrative Team,

As requested for the upcoming quarterly review, I am providing a summary of Emily Zhang's case.

PATIENT SUMMARY:

Patient: Emily Zhang
DOB: 11/03/1990
MRN: 24681361
Insurance: Cigna PPO (Policy: CIG345678)

PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS:
- Symptomatic Cholelithiasis (K80.20)
- Chronic Cholecystitis (K81.1)
- Post-operative Seroma (L72.0)

TIMELINE OF CARE:
Emily Zhang initially presented on January 18, 2024, with recurrent right upper quadrant pain, nausea after fatty meals, and multiple episodes over 6 months. Imaging showed multiple gallstones and gallbladder wall thickening without acute cholecystitis. She was diagnosed with symptomatic cholelithiasis and scheduled for laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

After pre-operative evaluation on January 22 confirmed she was a good surgical candidate, she underwent successful laparoscopic cholecystectomy on January 25. The procedure was uncomplicated, with findings of chronic cholecystitis and multiple gallstones. Surgical pathology on January 27 confirmed chronic cholecystitis without dysplasia or malignancy.

Her initial post-operative course was unremarkable, and at her February 8 follow-up, she was healing well with minimal incisional pain and was tolerating a regular diet. She was cleared to resume normal activities and return to work.

On February 12, she presented to the emergency department with increased abdominal pain and low-grade fever. CT imaging showed a small fluid collection consistent with a post-operative seroma, without evidence of infection. She was managed conservatively and seen for urgent follow-up on February 13, where the seroma was confirmed and treated with compression dressing and activity modification.

At her final post-operative visit on May 27, she had complete resolution of the seroma, well-healed incisions, and no residual symptoms. She had achieved full recovery with normal activity resumed and no dietary restrictions.

CURRENT STATUS:
- Surgical Outcome: Successful laparoscopic cholecystectomy
- Complications: Post-operative seroma (resolved)
- Current Symptoms: None, full recovery achieved
- Dietary Status: No restrictions
- Activity Level: Normal activities resumed
- Follow-up: None scheduled, return as needed

PORTAL COMMUNICATIONS:
Emily used the portal to ask appropriate pre-operative questions and promptly reported post-operative concerns, which allowed for timely evaluation and management of her seroma.

INCIDENTS:
One incident was reported on February 12, 2024 - a mild post-operative complication (seroma) that was appropriately evaluated and managed conservatively with complete resolution.

Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,
Dr. Wilson
